92fa017c15.q: What should you do to prepare for federal student loan payments restarting in October 2023?
92fa017c15.a: Drew Feitz recommends seven key actions: identify your student loan servicer through studentaid.gov, verify your loan information including amounts and interest rates, determine if you're on the right repayment plan, assess whether refinancing makes sense, submit an updated PSLF certification form if pursuing public service loan forgiveness, set up automatic payments to receive a 0.25% interest rate discount, and revisit your budget to accommodate the resumed payments.
92fa017c15.e: 13. How to Prepare for Student Loan Payments to Begin October 2023

0d2c736200.q: How do you find your student loan servicer on the Federal Student Aid website?
0d2c736200.a: Log in to studentaid.gov and go to your dashboard. On the right side you'll see a section titled 'My Loan Servicers' with a link to your student loan servicer's website. You should then create your login for that servicer's website, where you'll make payments and find all loan details.
0d2c736200.e: 13. How to Prepare for Student Loan Payments to Begin October 2023

570bd61c67.q: What are the different federal student loan repayment plans available?
570bd61c67.a: Seven repayment plans are currently available: the Standard Repayment Plan, Graduated Repayment Plan, Extended Repayment Plan, Save Plan (formerly the Repay Plan), Pay Plan, Income-Based Repayment Plan (IBR), and Income Contingent Repayment Plan (ICR). The Standard plan defaults to a 10-year payoff period if you don't take action.
570bd61c67.e: 13. How to Prepare for Student Loan Payments to Begin October 2023

1614a4bd73.q: What is the rule of thumb for deciding whether to refinance federal student loans?
1614a4bd73.a: If your student loan balance is less than your annual income, refinancing may be worth considering if you can obtain a lower interest rate from a private lender. If your balance exceeds your income, an income-driven repayment plan like Save or Pay may make more sense. However, refinancing means losing federal benefits like PSLF forgiveness, flexible repayment, and COVID-19 forbearance protections.
1614a4bd73.e: 13. How to Prepare for Student Loan Payments to Begin October 2023

bceb4ad5d9.q: What interest rate discount do you receive by setting up automatic payments on student loans?
bceb4ad5d9.a: Setting up automatic payments on your student loans provides a discount on your interest rate of 0.25%. It's important to verify that auto pay is activated on your student loan servicer's website, especially after the payment pause ends.
bceb4ad5d9.e: 13. How to Prepare for Student Loan Payments to Begin October 2023

b790f9025b.q: When does the federal student loan payment pause end and when do interest and payments resume?
b790f9025b.a: The federal student loan payment pause, which started March 13, 2020, ends on August 31, 2023. Forbearance continues through September 2023, but interest begins accruing on federal student loans on September 1, 2023, with payments due beginning October 2023.
b790f9025b.e: 13. How to Prepare for Student Loan Payments to Begin October 2023
